debate.key_bear_argument: Price trading below 200-day MA, weak short-term momentum (9/21 MAs bearish, stochRSI overbought), crisis-level macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 301+, FOMC today), below-average volume, and zero fundamental conviction create a high-risk, low-probability entry in a deteriorating environment.
